name: FinancialFilings
description: FinancialFilings is a unified API and database of public-company filings worldwide: company data, annual and interim reports, AI-ready Markdown and standardized financials.

events.d: Find filings by company, type, category, country or date, or get one filing's details.
Runs when a new filing is added for the chosen company, filing types, category or countries.
Get a filing's full text as AI-ready Markdown, whole or in a character window.
Search companies by name, ticker, ISIN, LEI or CIK, or get one company's full details.
Get a company's standardized income statement, balance sheet and cash flow (40 credits per call).
Remove a company from your FinancialFilings watchlist.
Find filings whose full text mentions a phrase, across all companies or chosen ones.
Add a company to your FinancialFilings watchlist.
